title: The Late Tide
author: Oscar Thackeray
blurb: Ada Ashgrove, a single parent running the town's only bookshop, swears the heart is a muscle like any other: trainable, containable. But when the anonymous pen-pal assignment pairs enemies instead of strangers, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must forgive the person in the mirror first, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
